hook: Someone got a ChatGPT-style AI running on a *35-year-old Super Nintendo*
caption:
Tech journalist Benj Edwards built a tiny chatbot that runs on a real Super Nintendo from a cartridge and types its replies word by word.
It is an unofficial 2.2 million parameter model distilled from OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-120b, not OpenAI's ChatGPT. Its answers are often wrong, and he says so.

What old console should run AI next?
